claims.statement: The D1-backed Scheduler is the single firing pipeline for automation ticks, manual Trigger Now, inbound events, and Session Durable Object run-complete callbacks.
The Worker scheduled handler runs Scheduler.tick() on the catch-all minute cron * * * * *, after dispatching dedicated image-build and abandoned-draft crons.

Each scheduler tick first recovery-sweeps orphaned starting and timed-out running runs, then processes up to 25 overdue automations with a 50-child launch budget so leftover overdue work waits for the next minute.
Orphaned starting runs older than 5 minutes are bulk-failed as session_creation_timeout; running runs older than EXECUTION_TIMEOUT_MS (default 90 minutes) are bulk-failed as execution_timeout.

Only schedule automations (and Trigger Now, which uses the same pipeline with source manual) may select more than one repository or environment; GitHub and Linear event triggers require exactly one repository and forbid environment targets.
Repositories and environments share a combined fan-out cap of MAX_AUTOMATION_REPOSITORIES, which aliases MAX_TARGET_REPOSITORIES (10).

Every firing records one automation_invocations row plus one automation_runs child per repository or environment target (or one repo-less child when there are no targets); invocation status is derived from children and is never stored.
Schedule and manual firings block on any active run of the automation; event firings block only on the event's concurrency key.

A concurrent schedule or event overlap is recorded as a childless skipped invocation with reason concurrent_run_active and without trigger_key; a manual overlap records nothing and surfaces as HTTP 409.

After three consecutive invocation-level failures the scheduler auto-pauses the automation; resume re-enables it, zeros consecutive_failures, and for schedule triggers recomputes next_run_at from the current time.
Failure accounting is per invocation via a failure_counted_at compare-and-set: any failed child in a fan-out is one strike, and the streak resets only when every sibling completed.
Inbound webhook automations accept POST /webhooks/automation/:id with Content-Type application/json, Authorization Bearer API key, and a 64 KB JSON body cap.
When an inbound webhook JSON body includes a string idempotencyKey, that value becomes both triggerKey and concurrencyKey; without it each delivery gets a random key so retries can overlap.
The webhook context block prepended to agent instructions labels the payload as untrusted input, truncates JSON at 4096 characters, and omits idempotencyKey from the agent-visible body.

Sentry automations accept POST /webhooks/sentry/:id, verify sentry-hook-signature as HMAC-SHA256 against the automation's encrypted client secret, and skip unsupported or malformed payloads without starting a run.

The github-bot normalizes supported GitHub webhook payloads with shared normalizeGitHubEvent and POSTs the envelope to /internal/github-event, which requireEventPoster restricts to the github-bot service principal.

The slack-bot filters ambient channel messages, normalizes them with shared normalizeSlackEvent, and POSTs to /internal/slack-event, which requireEventPoster restricts to the slack-bot service principal.

Shared triggerSources currently register Sentry, inbound webhook, GitHub, and Slack; Linear is typed on AutomationTriggerType and accepted by the automations API but has no registered trigger source and EVENT_SOURCE_SERVICE.linear is null.
Event matching requires every stored trigger condition to pass (AND) via matchesConditions against conditionRegistry.
Slack thread replies within 7 days of the root run's created_at continue the same session before conditions are evaluated; conditions gate only new runs.

Each launched automation child creates a session titled [Auto] plus the automation name with spawnSource automation, then enqueues the prompt with an automation callback context so the Durable Object calls Scheduler.runComplete on terminal.
One inaccessible repository at firing time pre-fails only that child; siblings still launch, and a fully failed resolution set finalizes immediately as one invocation failure.
Workflow Run Completed automations include the GitHub run attempt in triggerKey so each rerun can be admitted once, while concurrencyKey stays scoped to the workflow run id.
